package.name: robotops_trace_ros2_control
package.description: RobotOps Trace integration for ros2_control: RT-safe instrumentation of the controller / FollowJointTrajectory action-server boundary. Opens one detached SERVER span per goal (accept -> result) carrying the canonical goal UUID — the cross-process join key (ROB-427) that stitches the controller hop under the action client — plus the joint/trajectory semantic conventions. Nothing runs in the real-time update() control loop. Ships a reusable RT-safe traced-boundary helper plus a carried patch wiring it into stock joint_trajectory_controller. Built on the robotops_trace_cpp SDK core.
